title: Queue
description: A work item queue that buffers data items for processing by bots. Each queue is linked to a work item model defining its schema.

reactivationThreshold.description: Percentage threshold of remaining work items below which the queue triggers reactivation of additional bot instances

manualProcessingTime.description: Estimated manual processing time per work item for SLA calculations

manualProcessingTimeUnit.description: Time unit for manualProcessingTime (e.g., minutes, hours)

disallowDuplicate.description: Whether duplicate work items based on hash are rejected

autoRetryLimit.description: Maximum number of times a failed work item is automatically retried

status.description: Current operational status of the queue

workItemModelId.description: ID of the work item model defining this queue's data schema

workItemProcessingOrders.description: Ordered list of field names defining work item processing priority

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created this queue

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the queue was created

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last modified this queue

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification
